semiconductor_relevance: High — Hine Automation specializes in precision robotic wafer handling systems and components specifically designed for semiconductor OEMs.
summary: Hine Automation, LLC designs and manufactures advanced automation systems and robotic components for the semiconductor industry. Their products include vacuum and atmospheric wafer handling systems, modular Equipment Front-End Modules (EFEMs), and other automation solutions that enhance tool performance and reliability in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Vacuum and atmospheric wafer transport robots

regional_presence.United States: Hine Automation designs and builds its products in the USA, emphasizing local manufacturing and support.
